employees.desc: One row per employee. `manager_id` points to another `emp_id` (self-reference). `salary` can be NULL; `dept_id` can be NULL.

departments.desc: Departments. One department has no employees.

customers.desc: Customers of an online fashion and electronics store. Some never ordered.

products.desc: Catalogue with `price` (selling price) and `cost`. Prices in ₹.

orders.desc: One row per order (all of 2025). `status`: delivered / cancelled / returned. `payment_mode`: UPI, Card, COD, NetBanking, Wallet.

order_items.desc: Line items. Gross = quantity × unit_price. Net = gross × (1 − discount_pct/100).

restaurants.desc: Restaurant partners with city, cuisine and rating.

food_orders.desc: Orders Jan to Mar 2025. `order_time` / `delivered_time` are datetimes; delivered_time is NULL for cancelled orders.

ad_campaigns.desc: Restaurant ad campaigns: spend, impressions, clicks, attributed orders and revenue.

app_users.desc: Users who signed up (Jan to May 2025) with platform and acquisition channel.

app_events.desc: Event log: app_open, kyc_started, kyc_completed, first_deposit, first_trade. One row per event.

trades.desc: Trades with side BUY/SELL, quantity and price.

stock_prices.desc: Daily closing prices for RELIANCE, TCS, INFY (Jan 2025).

experiment_users.desc: A/B test: users split into control/treatment; `converted` is 0/1.

hubs.desc: Delivery hubs with city and zone.

riders.desc: Delivery riders, their hub and vehicle type.

shipments.desc: Shipments Jan to Mar 2025. `status`: delivered / rto (return to origin) / in_transit. `cost` in ₹; `cod_amount` > 0 means cash on delivery.

zone_targets.desc: Target cost per shipment for each zone.

raw_leads.desc: Raw marketing leads with messy names, emails, phones and duplicates. Made for cleaning practice.

loan_applications.desc: Loan applications with income, credit score (some NULL) and `defaulted` (0/1) target.

dialect: d + INTERVAL 7 DAY  /  DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
Not supported: LEFT JOIN UNION RIGHT JOIN
patterns: DENSE_RANK/ROW_NUMBER in a CTE, filter ≤ N
DISTINCT + LIMIT 1 OFFSET N−1, or DENSE_RANK = N
NOT EXISTS or LEFT JOIN … IS NULL
GROUP BY key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1; ROW_NUMBER to dedup
Recursive date spine or CROSS JOIN + LEFT JOIN
